name: gt7-endgame-native
description: iOS/Android shells for GT7 Endgame. The app itself is the web code in ../ (no fork).

scripts.ios: npm run web && npx cap add ios 2>/dev/null; npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.android: npm run web && npx cap add android 2>/dev/null; npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.sync: npm run web && npx cap sync
